Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
This week, Wizards of the Coast(R) will continue its Cybercast series
by covering the excitement at Origins '97. Cybercasts are RealAudio
"broadcasts" from our events, and Origins coverage will include the
Magic: The Gathering(R) U.S. National Championships *plus* a good
selection of special events going on throughout the weekend. Special
guests (Bruce Campbell & Tom Clancy), BattleTech championships, and
RoboRally championships are a few of the items we plan to bring you
this time. The schedule for the weekend can be found at:

http://www.wizards.com/Leagues_and_Tournaments/Cybercast/Origins.html

Below, you'll find the plain-text version of the weekend's schedule.

ORIGINS '97

Magic: The Gathering(R) U.S. National Championships offer resident
Magic: The Gathering players the chance to take home the national
title and represent the United States at the World Championships in
Seattle, Washington. The tournament takes place during Origins '97
and will receive full coverage all weekend, from the U.S. Open
tournament on Thursday to the final match on Sunday.

Bruce Campbell, star of *Army of Darkness* and *Brisco County Jr.*,
is a Guest of Honor at Origins '97. We'll record of one of his panel
sessions when it becomes available. Time: TBA

Tom Clancy, author of *Hunt for Red October* and other bestselling
novels, is also a Guest of Honor at Origins '97. We'll record of
one of his panel sessions when it becomes available as well. Time:
TBA

After the Acquisition: TSR and Wizards of the Coast, Inc. Discover
what's new at Wizards of the Coast! A question-and-answer session
hosted by Lisa Stevens will take place at 5:00 p.m. (EST) on Saturday,
July 19. We will try to get a recording of the session online by
8:00 p.m. (EST).

BattleTech(R) TCG Worlds. There will never be another chance to be
the first BattleTech world champion! We'll also try to cover the
triathlon series, including card, computer, and tabletop competition
in the BattleTech universe. Time: TBA.

RoboRally(R) Worlds. It is robot against robot in the 1997 RoboRally
World Championships. Paul Randles, head of the RoboRally team, will
recap some of the excitement. The Worlds start on Saturday at 10:00
a.m., but there's no time limit on the event, so keep watching for
the report on Saturday afternoon!

Magic: The Gathering US National Championships

NOTICE: Times here are subject to change since we're attempting to
cover other events at Origins besides the Magic Nationals. We will
update the schedule as necessary.

Thursday:
TBA U.S. Open wrap-up and U.S. Nationals preview

Friday:
Noon (EST) U.S. Nationals status
3:00 p.m. (EST) U.S. Nationals status
6:00 p.m. (EST) U.S. Nationals status
9:00 p.m. (EST) Nightly review

Saturday:
Noon (EST) U.S. Nationals status
3:00 p.m. (EST) U.S. Nationals status
6:00 p.m. (EST) U.S. Nationals status
9:00 p.m. (EST) Nightly review

Sunday:
Noon (EST) Reports will arrive approximately every three hours until
the finals start. At that time, the live feed will begin. Since there
is no time limit on these rounds, schedule forecasting is not possible.
Please stay tuned.
